verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a Warp SSH integration that carries terminfo, shell integration, or config to remote hosts. The SSH mentions it does contain cover the standalone Warp Agent CLI working inside any terminal over SSH, which is a different capability. Community remarks about SSH issues and using 'command ssh' as a workaround only hint that some wrapper exists and do not document the capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH to remote hosts with the terminal's own integration carrying my terminfo, shell integration, and config along
